scope: Theorem 8.1 (All row moments between the vacuum caps) of the manuscript “Cap-selected amplitudes and triangle chords for honeycomb walks” (preprints/Cap-selected-amplitudes-and-triangle-chords-for-honeycomb-walks-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 237 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 7fd6eb0adc06ad82), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 43. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let N, h ≥ 0 be integers. With ordered site variables b = (b1, . . . , bN ), the right and left vacuum caps Ψ, Λ, the scalar trace τ, and the Laurent polynomial part P of Sections 4–7, the following is an identity of meromorphic functions of the site variables, nonzero twist K, and row variables u1, . . . , uh: Λ h Y a=1 TK−1 (ua; b)Ψ = τ Qh a=1 P(ua)/dfull(ua)  τ(1) . (8.1) At a common-twist collision, the trace is the holomorphic specialization near a generic diagonal supplied by Proposition 6.1; colliding roots are retained by that continuation. Pointwise evaluation is at regular values of the meromorphic expressions, including repeated row arguments. For N = 0 the empty site and root conventions apply, and for h = 0 both sides are one.
